purpose: Train and evaluate portable forecasting models on real public fresh-retail data; never import records or models into user workspaces.

sample.selection: Sort distinct city_id/store_id/product_id keys by SHA256('gerai-freshretailnet-v1:' + key), take the first 500. Selection uses IDs only, never sales or test scores.

target: Sum of the next two observed daily sale_amount values, in the publisher's normalized sales units; not currency, physical item counts or ingredient consumption.
preprocessing: Use publisher dates/float values unchanged. Reject duplicates, gaps, negative/nonfinite targets or missing source rows; no zero filling, interpolation, recipe conversion, stockout recovery or synthetic fallback.
model: Existing Gerai Ridge two-day pipeline: lag/statistical features; calendar ablation; alpha 0.01/0.1/1/10/100 chosen on validation only.
internalEvaluation: Within the 90-day publisher train split: first 14 days form lags, last 14 target-days test, preceding 14 validation, earlier non-overlapping two-day targets train. Final coefficients fit train+validation only.
externalEvaluation: Publisher eval split untouched during training/tuning. Evaluate all three complete non-overlapping two-day origins in its seven dates. The seventh remaining day is not scored. Use earlier observed sales for lags, fixed coefficients, no refitting.
baselines: 2 * mean of previous seven observed daily sales
reporting: Report all 500 selected series, including failures and models worse than baseline. Aggregate MAE/WAPE, per-series metrics, stockout-affected versus unaffected targets, and internal qualification counts. Do not search for favorable series or retune after external evaluation.
restrictions: Public benchmark models are never activated for user accounts. Stockout-affected sales remain observed sales, not estimates of latent demand. This is not an Indonesian UMKM field evaluation. Qwen remains pretrained.
